{{Quote|We ran for cover. HJ-377 went mad, ran out towards the treeline, firing until all his rifle did was make clicking noises.|Imperial enlisted trooper|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''HJ-377''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] that fought for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] alongside another [[Unidentified stormtrooper (hill)|soldier]] during [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] reign<ref name="TFUII" /> before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="TFUIIC">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> While fighting a [[Unidentified rebel group|rebel group]], explosions and concussions shook the ground. Thinking it was the rebel fighters, HJ-377 went mad and ran towards a [[Tree/Legends|treeline]], firing his [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] until it was empty. In fact, the attack came not from the rebels, but rather from [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbit]], and [[Imperial Dropship Transport/Legends|Imperial dropships]] soon arrived to help the Imperial soldiers.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
HJ-377 was mentioned in the "Imperial dropship" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUII" />
